intro: A whistle cuts through the air.$Someone in uniform steps onto the path, and they are not smiling.
speaker: Pursuer
introDialogue: There you are.$Reports of Poké Ball theft. Descriptions matching YOU. A trail of very upset trainers.$I don't care whose badge you've dodged before —$today the law caught up.
title: Justice Pursuit
description: Your reputation precedes you: law enforcement has tracked you down, and there is no talking your way out of this one. The angrier the region gets, the faster — and stronger — they come.

1.label: Stand and Fight
1.tooltip:
(-) A forced battle against the law
(+) Nobody said crime was easy
1.selected: Resisting arrest, then. Noted for the report.$Team — move in!

2.label: Try to Run
2.tooltip:
(-) You cannot outrun a whistle
(-) A forced battle against the law
2.selected: A runner, huh? They're always runners.$We have the exits covered. We ALWAYS have the exits covered.$Team — move in!

outro: The pursuer retreats, muttering into a radio.$You get the distinct feeling this is not over.
